Breathe. It's dead. Are you hurt?
You were somewhere else while that thing was in your head. Where?
Home. A room that smelled of smoke and blackberries. I was small, on a chair far too big for me... and my father was by the fire, singing to me.
Then a wolf howled outside. He stopped, mid-song... and walked out into the dark. That was the last time I ever saw him.
That's the thing. I still can't see his face. Not once. Just his back... and his shadow on the wall.
Then what did it give you?
The song. I knew it before that night. An inn, full of people... him on a little stage, me at a table, swinging my legs. He sang it to me in front of all of them.
Your mother told you never to listen to his melody.
She did. And now I can't get it out of my head.
